purpose: Two gemologist concept mock-ups for El Unicornio, composed with distinct foreground gem displays for future parallax layer separation.

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one portrait 2:3 collectible card illustration of EL UNICORNIO as an earnest GEMOLOGIST closely examining a rare precious gemstone. This is the FIRST of two distinct gemologist scenario mock-ups: an intimate jeweler's workbench. Use the supplied reference ONLY for this established character's identity, faceted illustration style and colors, NOT its motorcycle scene, costume accessories, pose or expression.

CHARACTER: adult humanoid unicorn with a long angular PINK equine face and neck, pale lavender muzzle, upright pink ears, one long pearlescent pastel horn, small simple dark eyes, and short mane formed of distinct soft pastel rainbow bands (mint, pale yellow, blush pink, lavender). Pink HUMAN hands and human torso. Wear his signature PALE ICY-AQUA TURTLENECK with sage-mint folded high collar and the small unicorn-head emblem at the chest; a small glimpse of butter-yellow pants only if naturally visible. Remove biker helmet, sunglasses and black leather jacket completely so we can see his eyes and rainbow mane. No hooves, no quadruped, no human face. Endearingly serious, slightly derpy scholar, mouth closed in focused concentration, charmingly disproportionate long neck. He may wear a modest charcoal jeweler's apron over the sweater but keep turtleneck clear.

POSE / ACTION: waist-up seated at a gemologist's workbench, head and torso at a gentle three-quarter angle. He lifts a compact black-and-brass JEWELER'S LOUPE right to one eye with one pink hand; his other hand holds a rare brilliant-cut TEAL GEM delicately in fine jeweler's tweezers just in front of the loupe. The gemstone, tweezers and loupe must align plausibly for close visual inspection, in front of the upper side of his long equine face. His exposed other eye gently squints with professional concentration. Exactly two arms and hands. The main inspected gem should be believable handheld size, not an orb larger than his head. Make the face and tools readable at card size with clear silhouettes. No goggles or extra eyes.

SETTING AND PARALLAX COMPOSITION: A richly colored gem-cutting atelier. BACKGROUND: deep midnight-indigo cabinetry with a few small antique specimen drawers, softly lit arched window or restrained golden lamp light, simple jewel-like wall shapes, quiet space behind his full horn and face. MIDDLE: large unicorn at work, occupying the central and upper picture; clear silhouette, hands and gem visible. FOREGROUND: a dark plum velvet gem tray with three or four large clearly separated cut gemstones—ruby-red, emerald-green, violet and a pale iridescent stone—plus a modest crystal specimen and a small brass caliper resting on the workbench. Keep this foreground low in the frame, overlapping lower torso only, with visibly enlarged near gems to create depth without hiding his inspection gesture. No clutter of tiny objects. A warm brass task lamp at the edge may illuminate the gems without blocking the hero. Compose as a strong loteria-style character portrait, not a technical infographic.

STYLE: polished richly faceted LOW-POLY illustrated forms, saturated jewel colors and theatrical golden highlights matching the approved character reference. Deep blue and plum shadows, warm amber light on pink face and pale aqua sweater, crisp angular gemstone facets with controlled glints and subtle colored refracted light. A hint of magical rarity in the gems, but this is a recognizable gemologist at work. NOT photorealism, not raw game screenshot, not generic soft cartoon, not a furry animal. Full-bleed portrait approximately 1024x1536, ample horn clearance, no frame, lettering, numbers, labels, watermark, motorcycle or desert. Deliver ONE unified mock-up illustration, not separated layers or multiple panels.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a SECOND distinct El Unicornio GEMOLOGIST concept mock-up: 'The Rare-Gem Treasury'. Image 1 is the approved character reference for identity and rich faceted collectible-card illustration style; do not copy motorcycle setting or biker accessories. Image 2 is the first gemologist workbench variant and supports the pink unicorn's natural uncovered face, aqua turtleneck, rainbow mane, and magical gem colors; this second image must offer a clearly DIFFERENT pose, setting and composition, not another version of sitting with a jeweler's loupe at a desk.

SCENE: Inside an ancient but elegant jewel treasury: a tall recessed stone arch, a heavy OPEN circular vault door visible at one side in the distance, dark turquoise stone walls with restrained gold details, and a high narrow window casting a warm beam of light. Atmospheric midnight teal and violet with amber highlights. Quiet negative space behind the unicorn's head and full horn. The setting suggests a keeper of extremely rare mythical gems without symbols, written labels or elaborate lore.

CHARACTER: the same adult-proportioned humanoid unicorn: angular PINK long equine face and neck, lavender muzzle, modest simple dark eyes, upright pink ears, ONE long pearlescent pastel horn and short BANDED pastel rainbow mane (mint, soft yellow, pink, lavender). Pink human hands with natural fingers. Signature icy-aqua TURTLENECK with sage folded high collar and small unicorn-head chest emblem; butter-yellow trousers at the lower waist if visible. NO biker jacket, NO helmet, NO sunglasses, NO jeweler's apron in this variant. His slightly derpy sincerity remains; closed mouth and thoughtful appraising expression. Do not turn the unicorn into a human with a horn, a four-legged animal, or an angry exaggerated cartoon.

POSE: standing waist-up at a gentle three-quarter angle, head turned toward a spectacular rare translucent VIOLET-TO-TEAL CRYSTAL held upright at about shoulder/eye height in one pink hand. The crystal is larger than a normal cut gemstone but smaller than his head, a natural prismatic specimen with a few clear angular tips. He carefully supports its base with fingers below and tilts it into the warm window light, studying its internal color bands and inclusions. His other hand holds a small simple brass magnifying glass near the crystal, as if examining a detail within it. The magnifying lens is between his eye and the crystal, positioned physically plausibly with no duplicate eyes or disembodied instruments; keep his eye and face clearly visible. Crystal refracts controlled lavender, teal and gold highlights onto his fingers and the sweater. This is thoughtful professional appraisal, not spellcasting or a crystal weapon. Clear two-arm/two-hand anatomy and an elegant readable gesture.

COMPOSITION FOR THREE FUTURE PARALLAX PLANES: BACKGROUND: recessed vault architecture and restrained distant gem-storage alcoves, softly simplified. MIDDLE: large unicorn upper-body portrait with raised rare specimen; entire horn and crystal within frame and face unobscured. FOREGROUND: an open dark teal velvet-lined treasure coffer sitting low across the bottom, with three or four distinct impressive gems or crystal specimens: a ruby-red cut stone, a golden citrine crystal and a pale luminous opal among them. A few large, sharply rendered gem facets overlap the lower edge, creating strong near depth. Do not hide the hero's hands or scatter tiny floating gems. Put enough distance between foreground coffer and character to imply depth. No full body, clutter, characters in the background, paperwork or text.

STYLE: match the rich polished angular LOW-POLY FACETED illustrated r-cana card style, saturated jewel palette, theatrical warm gold edge lighting, deep turquoise shadows, crystal clarity and gentle mysterious glow. Crisp sculpted planes, designed silhouettes and expressive light, NOT photorealism, NOT a raw 3D game screenshot, NOT soft airbrush children's art. Full-bleed portrait 2:3 approximately 1024x1536, no border, typography, logos, numbers, stats or watermarks. Output ONE unified concept illustration, not a collage, triptych or separated layers.
